sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body: The gameplay in Wild Deer Hunting 3D is centered around navigating through the African jungle, where you'll encounter various wild animals, including deers, lions, elephants, and foxes. The game's objective is to hunt down these animals using various guns and pistols, each with its own unique characteristics and shooting ranges. To start, you'll need to choose your preferred gun, which will determine your shooting range and accuracy. Once you've selected your gun, you'll need to navigate through the jungle, spotting your prey and taking them down using the left mouse button to aim and shoot.
sections.body continuation: The game's controls are straightforward, with the left mouse button used for aiming and shooting, and the right mouse button used for changing guns. The game also features a speedometer, which indicates your jeep's speed, and a health meter, which tracks your character's health. When your character's health drops to zero, the game is over. To avoid this, you'll need to keep an eye on your health meter and replenish your health by picking up health packs scattered throughout the jungle. The game also features a scoring system, where you earn points for each animal you hunt down, with bonus points awarded for hunting down rare and elusive animals.
